notes.title: 2024-05-29 - Touchscreen support for Windows & Linux + Other Changes & Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]
- Ouros should now support touchscreen for Windows devices such as the Microsoft Surface and the ROG Ally.
- Ouros also supports touchscreen on Linux. It was already supported on Steam Deck, you can use touch there too!
- Increased touch radius for control points
- updated unity version (2022.3.30f1)
- Pause Button shown in Level Selector

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Handle Empty Save File Bug
- "Flip Direction" sound now respects volume settings

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
- macOS sometimes crashes on launch (close and relaunch again if this happens)
